sources.title: Solving MaxSAT and #SAT on structured CNF formulas
sources.role: Defines PS-width and proves #SAT and weighted MaxSAT in O(k^3 s(m+n)) for a supplied width-k decomposition.

sources.title: Understanding model counting for beta-acyclic CNF-formulas
sources.role: Proves polynomial beta-acyclic #SAT by elimination and demonstrates tractability beyond the PS-width dynamic-programming framework.

sources.title: Non-FPT lower bounds for structural restrictions of decision DNNF
sources.role: Separates incidence-treewidth structure from restricted decision-DNNF and OBDD compilation guarantees.

sources.title: On complexity of restricted fragments of Decision DNNF
sources.role: Refines restricted decision-DNNF lower-bound methodology and relaxed structured compilation models.

sources.title: Tractability Beyond beta-Acyclicity for Conjunctive Queries with Negation
sources.role: Introduces nest-set width and proves fixed-parameter tractability of SAT parameterized by this elimination width.
